manifest.description: Contact forms for your pages: the message is checked for spam, kept, and emailed to you.
manifest.author: oks-page

options.label: A box to tick to agree
Choices, with a bar between: Red|Blue

thanks_page.label: Or go to this page after sending, e.g. /thanks

send_to.label: Send to (addresses, commas); empty: plugin setting

confirm.label: Email a confirmation to the sender (field Email)

settings.title: Contact us
settings.thanks: Thank you. We will write back soon.

settings.title: Ask for an offer

fields.label: When do you need it?
fields.options: As soon as possible|This month|Later|Just looking

settings.thanks: Thank you. We will send you an offer soon.

settings.title: Call me back
settings.thanks: Thank you. We will call you back.

settings.title: Stay in touch

fields.label: I agree to get news by email

settings.note: We use your email only to send you news. You can ask us to stop at any time.

send_to.label: Send messages to (addresses, separated by commas)

privacy_page.label: Your privacy page, e.g. /privacy (linked under forms)

blocked_words.label: Words that mark a message as spam, separated by commas

keep_months.label: Months to keep messages (1 to 36, default 12)
